author: Tech_Bender
body:
Step 1 - Find a friend with a smart phone.

Step 2 - Say "Hey, I know this great game you should play, it's called Orna."

Step 3 - They make an account and you party up.

Step 4 - Use monster remains until a bandit lord appears.

When you invite someone to your party they can't fight monsters above their tier so it dramatically lowers the level of enemies you will see spawning. Since the bandit lord is a tier 1 boss, you have a much higher change of seeing him with a low level friend in your party. Bonus points for getting someone else hooked on the game also.

author: MilesSand
body:
All bosses can spawn anywhere. As long as your tier is below the minimum you can see them.

But it's probably quicker to do a couple dungeon runs at the minimum tier.
